caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal plate with decorative features, rendered primarily in shades of gray and brownish tones. The central part of the plate contains a large circular medallion with a floral motif in the middle surrounded by leaf designs, enclosed within a raised, irregularly-circular border. Four smaller circles are positioned at each corner of the rectangular plate, each containing a similar leaf motif. In the upper region of the rectangle, there are two protruding hooks or latches. The surface of the plate shows subtle highlights and shadows, indicating dimensional relief and texture. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset technical diagram showing the dimensions of the plate (3.5 inches by 2.5 inches) and a simplified overhead view with key features indicated. The background is plain, and there is a faint border around the main feature. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature and a date.
title: Iron Cellar Door
